## Merge checklist

- [ ] The PR targets `main` from an `agent/*` branch.
- [ ] The change is limited to the stated WBS / issue scope.
- [ ] No secret, production data, credential, or populated environment file is included.
- [ ] Documentation and tests are updated where behavior or contracts changed.
- [ ] All review conversations are resolved.
- [ ] The required `quality` status check is successful and up to date.
- [ ] CODEOWNERS and any stage-gate reviewers have been included as required.
